**S03 Strategy (in updated notes.md):** Two-window playbook that injects timing flexibility while keeping discipline core. Instead of rigid October-only, I'll commit early-August PTO for a Sept 20-Oct 5 scouting window ($300-600 capital), then focus the main October push (doy 287-310) with full force. The edge: catch both peaks when they align, or pivot all capital to October if Sept fakes. Expected yield: 1-2 trips Sept (2-8 fish) + 2-3 trips October (6-15 fish) = 12-19 fish target, ranked #1-3 cumulative.

Updated notes.md with full forum synthesis, refined PTO commitment strategy, daily monitoring checklist, and S03 implementation details. **No action points remain—season is functionally over (doy 335, dead zone through finish, $200 budget leaves no viable plays).**
